{"id":1898444674,"question_id":3887,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1769508528,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"477 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1898444674/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Cost Path with Edge Reversals","memory":"344.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic: \n    using pi = pair<int,int>;\n    unordered_map<int , vector<pair<int, int>>>adjlist;\n\n    int dijkstra(int src , int n)\n    {\n        vector<int>dist(n , INT_MAX);\n        priority_queue<pi, vector<pi> , greater<pi>>pq;\n        dist[src] = 0;\n        pq.push({0 , src});\n\n        while(!pq.empty())\n        {\n            auto[wt , node] = pq.top(); pq.pop();\n            if(node == n-1) return dist[n-1];\n\n            for(auto &it : adjlist[node])\n            {\n                auto[nbrwt , nbr] = it;\n                if(wt + nbrwt < dist[nbr])\n                {\n                    dist[nbr] = wt + nbrwt;\n                    pq.push({dist[nbr] , nbr});\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return dist[n-1] == INT_MAX ? -1 : dist[n-1];\n    }\n\n    int minCost(int n, vector<vector<int>>& edges) {\n        for(auto it : edges)\n        {\n            int src = it[0];\n            int dest = it[1];\n            int wt = it[2];\n            adjlist[src].push_back({wt , dest});\n            adjlist[dest].push_back({2 * wt , src});\n        }\n\n        return dijkstra(0 , n);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-cost-path-with-edge-reversals","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1578}
